sous_titre: Millions d'embauches par mois, de mars à juillet 2026

Mars 2026.texte: Over the month, hires increased to 5.6 million while total separations changed little at 5.4 million.

Avril 2026.texte: The number and rate of hires decreased to 5.1 million (-419,000) and 3.2 percent, respectively, in April.

Mai 2026.texte: Hires were unchanged at 5.2 million, while total separations changed little at 5.1 million.

Juillet 2026.texte: The number and rate of hires were little changed at 5.1 million and 3.2 percent, respectively, over the month.
